source_en: Oh, fantastic. Another fresh inspector. Straight out of the academy?
Three tours. I've seen that hopeful look before. You all lose it.
So what did they prepare you for? Be honest.
The basics. Enough to do the job.
The basics. That'll keep you breathing for maybe two days.
Ha. At least you're honest. You still won't last.
I'll be generous. Three days. Four if nothing shows up. And it will.
Last guy here saw something he couldn't explain. Nobody listened. Then he stopped talking too.
So settle in, Inspector. Enjoy feeling in control while it lasts, before you...
